![手工打造](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pJmCFF0p/e89faefc522d601db2a5fd70136f37ef7ce18569.png) --- [![由 Terrarium 制作](https://images.teamresourceful.com/u/I80VLV.svg)](https://discord.terrarium.earth) [![需要 Resourceful Lib](https://images.teamresourceful.com/u/jUWHY2.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourceful-lib) --- ### 📖关于 📖
来自《Chipped》的创作者，我们带来了《Handcrafted》！一款让你的房子变成温馨家园的模组！:D 你在寻找奇幻、蒸汽朋克或中世纪风格的装饰吗？还是想坚持更原汁原味的原版风格？无需多虑！我们为你准备了超过 250 件家具供你挑选。无论是椅子、桌子、长凳还是书桌；所有物品都已整齐地打包进这一个模组中。这个模组将提供你所需的一切家具，让你的方块小屋真正变成一个家！ ---
### 开发者： Alex Nijjar, CodexAdrian, MsRandom, ThatGravyBoat ### 美术： Kekie6, Facu, Marc-IceBlade --- [![与好友同乐的最佳方式。使用 Essential Mod 游玩](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/756fb1751d3dfa52c30b3df587894a9b99186e97_0.webp)](http://essential.gg/) --- ### 社交媒体 [![YouTube](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/social/youtube-plural_vector.svg)](https://youtube.terrarium.earth) [![Twitch](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/social/twitch-plural_vector.svg)](https://www.twitch.tv/terrariumearth) [![Twitter](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/social/twitter-plural_vector.svg)](https://twitter.terrarium.earth) [![Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/donate/kofi-plural_vector.svg)](https://kofi.terrarium.earth) [![Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://discord.terrarium.earth) [![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/organization/terrarium) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy-minimal/available/curseforge_vector.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/terrariumearth/projects) --- ### 探索我们的其他项目
